author: NPR Music
description:
Madison Square Garden is Harry's house until Oct. 31. Harry Styles is performing a 30-night residency to promote his new album, Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.⁠
⁠
NPR Music host Isabella Gomez Sarmiento spoke to fans outside of the arena to see how far they traveled, and how much they spent to see the pop star.⁠
⁠
Host: Isabella Gomez Sarmiento/NPR⁠
Producer: Nikki Birch/NPR
title: Madison Square Garden is Harry's house until Oct. 31.
